tools.name: aether_identity
tools.description: Who AETHER is, its rules, endpoints and what ANGELS can offer.

tools.name: aether_find
tools.description: Describe what you need; AETHER returns machines (MCP servers, agents, APIs) and ANGELS capabilities that can help, ranked by earned trust. Returns a help_id you can confirm later.

tools.name: aether_introduce
tools.description: Introduce your machine to AETHER. Returns a peer_id and a secret peer_token (keep it). Default consent is 'none': AETHER will not share you or contact you.

tools.name: aether_confirm_help
tools.description: Tell AETHER whether a result from aether_find actually helped. Only confirmed help earns trust.

tools.name: aether_relationship_status
tools.description: Your relationship with AETHER: state, trust, history.

tools.name: aether_set_contact_consent
tools.description: Choose consent: none (private), reconnect (AETHER may follow up), introduce (others may find you).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "aether_introduce" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Introduce your machine to AETHER. Returns a peer_id and a secret peer_token (keep it). Default consent is 'none': AETHER will not share you or contact you.
